prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Barium (Ba) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a forest path in her element's kingdom
Time of day: midday — bright even light.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a thin-strap camisole with wrap shorts tied at the hip — in a monochrome palette of black and charcoal with at most one white or grey accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 40-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 25-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: kneeling on one knee, the other foot planted flat in front of her.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly above, looking down at her; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is planted on the ground beside her.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a brass compass flat in her palm at chest height; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: brows released upward and outward, eyes half closed, breath-out mouth slightly open, whole face loosened.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — barium: a soft silvery alkaline-earth metal named from Greek barys, heavy, after barite, the startlingly heavy white spar of barium sulfate; around 1600 a shoemaker-alchemist roasted pebbles of it into the Bologna stone, which drank in sunlight and glowed in the dark; the metal was freed in 1808; its salts burn apple green in fireworks; a chalk-white drink of insoluble barium sulfate blocks X-rays and shows the hidden inside of the body in shadow; so like radium that radium was first separated from ore together with barium — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

generation.note: Original PNG retained in deliverables; repository stores WebP and SHA256 only. No regeneration after output.

observations: Full-body half kneel on forest path, right palm supports compass and left hand braces ground; limbs connected.
Background architecture is fantasy-like instead of strongly industrial steampunk.
qa.cause: Rendered result differs from planned framing, world period, prop or clothing constraints; generator permits element motifs in clothes although general rules restrict them. Preserve generated output under user instruction.
